The '''''Wild Menagerie''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-1930 transport/Legends|YT-1930]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] that was owned by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zan Ransom]]. Ransom heavily modified the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], improving its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], [[Life support/Legends|life-support]], weaponry, and security systems. He used the ''Wild Menagerie'' to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] the exotic creatures he captured as part of his trade.

==Description==
The ''Wild Menagerie'' was a modified [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-1930 transport/Legends|YT-1930]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], a model in the successful [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] had a class 1 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], an improvement over the class 2 hyperdrive that came with stock YT-1930s. Unlike most [[Transport/Legends|transports]], the ''Wild Menagerie'' had a fully functioning [[Life support/Legends|life-support]] system in the cargo area to facilitate living cargo. The 35-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long freighter's capacity allowed for one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], one passenger, 200 metric tons of cargo, and four [[Time/Legends|months]]' worth of consumables. The ship's weapons systems had also been upgraded with a [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]] and a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|belly gun]] set to [[Stun/Legends|stun]]. In addition, the ''Wild Menagerie'' had upgraded [[Targeting computer/Legends|fire control]] systems and expensive security systems. With all these modifications, the ship was valued at 208,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] compared to the 135,000 credits for an unchanged YT-1930.<ref name="MS" />

==History==
The YT-1930 light freighter ''Wild Menagerie'' was owned by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zan Ransom]]. Ransom specialized in acquiring rare and unusual specimens of exotic creatures from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The bounty hunter heavily modified the light freighter, improving its hyperdrive and fitting the cargo area with a fully functioning life-support system for his living cargo. Ransom's illegal trade regularly got him in trouble with local authorities, so he equipped the ''Wild Menagerie'' with a quad laser cannon. He also added a belly gun that was set to stun for knocking down large animals.<ref name="MS" />

==Owners and operators==
The ''Wild Menagerie'' was owned and operated by the bounty hunter Zan Ransom, who specialized in acquiring rare and exotic creatures.<ref name="MS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Wild Menagerie'' was created for [[Starships of the Galaxy|''More Starships!'']], a web enhancement for the [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook [[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'']]. It was written by [[Brian Campbell]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[November 15]], [[2001]]. The web enhancement leaves the time period in which the ''Wild Menagerie'' was in operation unspecified, however as the YT-1930 came into production shortly before [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|disbanded]] the [[Senate]]<ref name="MS" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> it would have been sometime after that date.<ref name="MS" />
